finding.title: Segment operating-profit growth had divergent margin trends
finding.observation: Productivity and Business Processes operating income grew 20.2%, contributed 52.8% of FY26 operating-income growth, and expanded margin 216 bps to 59.9%. Intelligent Cloud operating income grew faster at 27.8% and contributed 46.4% of growth, but its margin declined 61 bps to 41.3%; More Personal Computing operating income grew 1.6%, contributed 0.8%, and had a 26.6% margin. Consolidated operating margin increased 116 bps to 46.8%.
finding.why_it_matters: Consolidated operating-margin expansion reflects materially different segment outcomes: Productivity and Business Processes provided strong margin expansion, while Intelligent Cloud growth coexisted with margin compression and More Personal Computing contributed little incremental operating income.
investigation_questions: What disclosed drivers explain the Productivity and Business Processes margin expansion?
What explains Intelligent Cloud margin compression despite 27.8% operating-income growth?
How did the segment margin changes combine to produce the 116-bps consolidated operating-margin increase?
